meta.description:
Checks that the top level components of the SBOM carry at least
one cryptographic hash of the component artifact. This implements
the _Component Hash Value_ element of the CISA 2026 SBOM Minimum
Elements.
meta.name: Component Hash Value

error.message: One or more top level components have no cryptographic hash of the component artifact
error.guidance: Add checksums (SPDX) or hashes (CycloneDX) to each top level component, or explicitly mark the hash as unknown

assessment.message: All top level components have hash values
